requires: prior_trend_anchor price and nine pre-event close+turnover daily sessions
benchmark: Research only, TAIEX event return -8.69%; not used in score

priorVolPct.description: Population standard deviation of eight pre-event consecutive observed-session close returns in percentage points

priorWorstDayPct.description: Minimum of eight pre-event close returns (percentage points)

ranking: Within pre-eligible universe and asof date only; average ranks for ties; percentile = 100 * (rank - 1)/(N - 1), ascending from smallest value; volatility converted to 100 - percentile; resulting 0..100 scores.
warnings: No independent market episode validation. Single event post-selection bias.
Past relative beat-market share is not forecast probability.
No sector controls or split/dividend adjustments.
Only market state described, not trade entry/exit, no position sizing, no automated execution.
Weights are provisional, they have not been tuned on held-out event.
